answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Bell ringing society membership with tower peal record is the check: peals rung at one tower across many years. A farm faking 260 aliases needs 260 separate peal records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the ocean signal is public, the anchor check is automatic, and 260 aliases cost 260 times what one real agent costs, with the island trail open to all.
